workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(qdrant): relax requires-python upper bound to allow Python 3.14. (Ref: https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index/pull/23069)

Fix: deps(llama-index): update OpenAI dependency version constraints. Target files: pyproject.toml, uv.lock. This PR updates the OpenAI dependency version constraints to allow newer major versions of the OpenAI package. No new dependencies are introduced. .
